This script generates the MIC distribution plots 

```{r setup, include=FALSE, message=F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
subdir_name <- "Rscripts/1_MIC_distributions"
pkgs = c('here','data.table','ggplot2','janitor','knitr','tidyverse','phytools','reshape2','patchwork')
new.pkgs <- pkgs[!(pkgs %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
install.packages(new.pkgs, INSTALL_opts = '--no-lock', dependencies = TRUE)
lapply(pkgs, require, character.only = TRUE)

```

```{r knit, echo = F,eval=F,warning=F,include=F}
results_path = here::here("results")
rmarkdown::render(input = here("scripts", str_c(subdir_name, ".Rmd")), output_dir = results_path)
```

# Load data
```{r environmental, echo= F}
df <- read.csv('/rivm/s/puntm/2026_black_aspergillus/data/2026_meta_info.csv') %>% 
  select(-1) %>%
  mutate(across(c(itc,pos,vrc,dif,pth,teb,pro), ~ gsub('32','>16',.x))) %>% 
  mutate(lineage = case_when(species == 'aspergillus niger' ~ 'ANL',
                             species == 'aspergillus tubingensis' ~ 'ATL',
                             species == 'aspergillus brasiliensis' ~ 'ABL',
                             T ~ NA))


df_info <- df %>% select(strain, specimen_types) %>% 
  mutate(specimen_types = case_when(strain == 'V087-12' ~ 'Environmental',
                                    specimen_types == 'Lung' ~ 'Bronchial lavage',
                                    T ~ specimen_types,
                                    )) %>% 
  group_by(specimen_types) %>% 
  mutate(env = 78, clin = 243-78) %>% 
  summarise(n(), n()/env, n()/clin) %>% distinct()
```

# Set-up parameters
```{r functions}
source(here("src", "theme.R"))
source(here("src", "MIC_plot_functions.R"))
```

# Organize the MIC levels
```{r process}
mic_levels  <- c("0.031", "0.062", "0.125", "0.25", "0.5", "1", "2", "4", "8", "16", ">16")
mic_columns <- c("itc", "pos", "vrc", "vor", "teb", "pro", "dif", "pth")
# Function to apply this order to a column
reorder_column_fixed <- function(x) {
  factor(x, levels = mic_levels, ordered = TRUE)
}
# List of MIC columns in your dataframe
# Apply to all MIC columns
for (col in mic_columns) {
  if (col %in% names(df)) {
    df[[col]] <- reorder_column_fixed(df[[col]])
  }
}
df_sp <- df %>% filter(species %in% c('aspergillus niger','aspergillus tubingensis'))



```


#Create tables
```{r table}
breakpoints <- c(itc = 2, vrc = 4, pos = 0.5, pro = 8, pth =4, dif = 16, teb =16)

table_df = df %>% 
  mutate(across(c(itc,pos,vrc,dif,pth,teb,pro), ~ as.numeric(gsub('>16','32',.x)))) %>% 
  mutate(groups = case_when(origin == 'Clinical' & location == 'The Netherlands' ~ 'NL Clinical',
                            origin == 'Clinical' & location == 'Belgium'         ~ 'BE Clinical',
                            specimen_types == 'Environmental (hotspot)'          ~ 'Hotspot',
                            specimen_types == 'Environmental'          ~ 'Environmental',
                            T ~ NA)) %>% 
  select(groups, lineage, itc:pth) %>% 
  group_by(groups,lineage) %>% 
   summarise(
    Total_In_Group = n(),
    # We create two results for every column: NWT count and Total Tested count
    across(itc:pth, list(
      nwt = ~ sum(.x > breakpoints[cur_column()], na.rm = TRUE),
      tested = ~ sum(!is.na(.x))
    ), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )

table_final <- table_df %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with("_nwt"), 
                ~ paste0(.x, "/", get(gsub("_nwt", "_tested", cur_column()))),
                .names = "{gsub('_nwt', '_ratio', .col)}")) %>%
  # Optionally select only the columns you want to show
  select(groups, lineage, Total_In_Group, contains("_ratio"))

head(table_final)



```

Making an overview of the correlation between MICs

```{r}
corr_df_anl = df %>% filter(species == 'aspergillus niger') %>% 
  mutate(across(c(itc,pos,vrc,dif,pth,teb,pro), ~ log2(as.numeric(gsub('>16','32',.x))))) %>% select(itc:pth)

corr_df_atl = df %>% filter(species == 'aspergillus tubingensis') %>% 
  mutate(across(c(itc,pos,vrc,dif,pth,teb,pro), ~ log2(as.numeric(gsub('>16','32',.x))))) %>% select(itc:pth)

get_lineage_matrix = function(lineage){
  corr_matrix = round(cor(lineage,use = 'complete.obs'),2)
  corr_matrix[upper.tri(corr_matrix, diag = TRUE)] <- NA
  melted_corr <- reshape2::melt(corr_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
  return(melted_corr)
}
anl_matrix = get_lineage_matrix(corr_df_anl) %>% mutate(lineage = 'ANL')
atl_matrix = get_lineage_matrix(corr_df_atl) %>% mutate(lineage = 'ATL')
matrices = rbind(anl_matrix,atl_matrix)

blue = hcl.colors(5, "Blues 3")[4]
red  = rev(hcl.colors(5, "Reds 3"))[4]

# 4. Plot with text labels
corplot = ggplot(data = matrices, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = value)) + 
  geom_tile(color = "white") + 
  facet_grid(~lineage) +
  
  # Add this layer to show the values
  geom_text(aes(label = value), color = "black", size = 3.5) + 
  
  scale_fill_gradient2( low = blue, mid = "white", high =red, 
                       limit = c(-1,1), space = "Lab", midpoint = 0, 
                       name="Pearson\nCorrelation") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_fixed() + 
  labs(title = "", x = "", y = "")

corplot

```



Make an overview of the MICs of the agricultural azoles for ECOFFinder
```{r}
agri_overview = df %>% filter(!is.na(teb)) %>% 
  select(strain, pro,teb,dif,pth) %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(pro,teb,dif,pth)) %>%
  group_by(name, value) %>% count() %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = value,
                                                    values_from = n,
                                                    names_from = name) %>% arrange(desc(value)) %>% 
  select(value,pro,teb,dif,pth)

kable(agri_overview)

```


# Build plots
Separate by species. 
```{r plots_2_species,fig.width=10, fig.height=6, out.width="100%"}

p1_sep <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"itc",clin_env_set, "Itraconazole", mic_levels, "2",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'lineage')
p2_sep <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"pos",clin_env_set, "Posaconazole", mic_levels, "0.5",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'lineage')
p3_sep <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"vrc",clin_env_set, "Voriconazole", mic_levels, "4",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'lineage')

azole_species_plots <-(p1_sep + p2_sep + p3_sep) + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 3, guides = "collect")&
  theme(legend.position='bottom', 
         strip.text = element_text(size =12)
  )
azole_species_plots
```

Now we do the same for the agricultural fungicides:

```{r plots_3_agri,fig.width=10, fig.height=8, out.width="70%"}
p4 <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"pro",clin_env_set, "Prochloraz",      mic_levels, "8",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'lineage')
p5 <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"pth",clin_env_set, "Prothioconazole", mic_levels, "4",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'lineage')
p6 <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"dif",clin_env_set, "Difenoconazole",  mic_levels, "16",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'lineage')
p7 <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"teb",clin_env_set, "Tebuconazole",    mic_levels, "16",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'lineage')

azole_agri_plots <- (p4 + p5 + p6 + p7) + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect")&
  theme(legend.position='bottom', 
         strip.text = element_text(size =12)
  )
azole_agri_plots
```

# Save the plots

```{r}
dir_path = here::here("plots")
dir_res = here::here("results")
ggsave(filename = glue::glue("{dir_path}/Fig_1_mic_species_plots.svg"), plot = azole_species_plots,  width = 12,  height =6,   bg = "white")
ggsave(filename = glue::glue("{dir_path}/Fig_2_mic_agri_plots.svg"), plot = azole_agri_plots,  width = 8,  height = 8,   bg = "white")
ggsave(filename = glue::glue("{dir_path}/Fig_3_correlation_plots.svg"), plot = corplot,  width = 7,  height =3.6,   bg = "white")

openxlsx::write.xlsx(table_final, file = glue::glue("{dir_res}/NWT_overview.xlsx"))

```
